title: Foiled Ilocos Norte shooting: How much of our private chats is being watched, and by whom?
summary: A mass shooting plot foiled in Batac City, Ilocos Norte over the weekend is just an example of how authorities can dig deep and quickly into private conversations of regular individuals.
